notes.title: [Play Now]Gold Drill has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248327/4650e004d372a7930eb4a876098126f153e6116d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2084820/Gold_Drill/

[b]Introduction[/b]
[list][*]Gold Drill is a classic arcade puzzle game where you connect pipes[/list]
[list][*]Clear the stage and enjoy the rewards the girls give you![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42248327/47c92033f8ac115bf567041a2bb58d8ece5761d1.png[/img]

[b]How to play the game[/b]
[list][*]It is cleared by connecting from the start point to the end point with the provided block.[/list]
[list][*]Unique blocks can help or hinder your play[/list]
[list][*]If the game is difficult, refer to the hint[/list]
[list][*]Enjoy your joy by earning rewarded videos! [/list]

[b]Key Features[/b]
[list][*]3 girl friends embodied in 3D[/list]
[list][*]30 stages filled with blocks with unique characteristics[/list]
[list][*]Extreme fun, challenge mode + 30 stages[/list]
[list][*]30 adult video records given as rewards[/list]
[list][*]An emergency mode that will protect you from your mother and sister![/list]

notes.title: VER.1.0.2 Now Available!!!
notes.content:
[b]-Bug Fix [/b]
"Get Rachel. I begin to love Rachel." Achievement bug fix

[b]- The difficulty level has been modified. [/b]
Boss's homing bullet skill nerf

Minions speed has decreased.

Speed up the player at some difficulty levels

notes.content:

notes.title: VER.1.0.1 Now Available!!!
notes.content:
[b]- The difficulty level has been modified. [/b]
Press the "H" key to speed up the player.

[b]- If you have more than 10 hearts, you can select the next characters.[/b]
Maggie: 10hearts / Rachel: 20hearts (At least one heart per stage)
